brief: Prioritise pre-event attention for this ageing unit to address any outstanding work affecting its ability to shed heat, in descending order of priority from cooling and ventilation defects to oil leaks and condition defects [SOP-016]. If the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified [MG-021].
